Premium Prices, Amateur Cocktails
Sep 2026 • Friends
As for the cocktails, I genuinely have to wonder: were these drinks made by someone on their first day?

I understand that everyone has to start somewhere, and there is absolutely nothing wrong with having new staff. But if the cocktails are going to be served to paying customers at premium prices, perhaps the staff should be properly trained before being left behind the bar.

The drinks were poorly balanced, lacked depth, and simply did not taste like professionally made cocktails. At these prices, “they’re new” is hardly a satisfying explanation.

I came for well-crafted cocktails, not a live training session.

Expensive Drinks, Disappointing Experience”
Aug 2026 • Friends
An interesting experience, if your idea of a great night is paying premium prices to discover how little music and cocktails can actually offer.
The music was impressively loud, although unfortunately volume seems to have been prioritized over taste. It was almost impossible to have a conversation, which I suppose is one creative way of preventing guests from discussing the evening.
As for the drinks, they certainly had confidence — unfortunately, the cocktails themselves did not have much else. At these prices, I expected something refined, balanced, and memorable. What I received was mostly an expensive reminder that presentation cannot compensate for quality.
There is clearly a lot of ambition here, and I genuinely admire that. I just wish the drinks and music had been given the same attention as the prices.
A truly memorable evening — mostly because I’ll remember not to come back.
Save your money and choose somewhere else. If you’re looking for good music, well-crafted drinks, and an enjoyable night out, I strongly recommend going literally anywhere else.

TedNg254
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We’re sorry that your evening at Moon Men did not meet your expectations.

Regarding pricing, our menu prices have remained largely unchanged for the past three years and are within the normal range for cocktail bars in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Moon Men also occupies a rather unique location, offering a direct view of the back of St. Joseph’s Cathedral.

Regarding the music, we rarely receive feedback that the volume is uncomfortably loud. However, every evening and every guest’s experience can be different. Guests are always welcome to let our team know directly during their visit, and we are happy to adjust the volume whenever possible, as we regularly do upon request. We’re sorry that our team did not realize the volume was affecting your experience that evening.

As for the cocktails, taste is naturally subjective, and we respect your personal experience. Moon Men has developed a collection of signature cocktails, each with its own concept, recipe, and presentation. If you would like a broader reference for our signature cocktails, you can also view photos on Moon Men’s official website or Google listing. Nevertheless, we take your comments regarding balance and quality seriously and will review them with our bar team.

Once again, we’re sorry that your experience did not meet your expectations, and we appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback.
